title: Knitted vase collection
author: user_3025982475
description:
Knitted Vase Collection

This collection includes three vases generated from a single parametric model.

The design is based on a set of adjustable parameters that allow the shape to evolve while maintaining a consistent visual language. The surface features a “knitted” pattern, creating a balance between geometric precision and organic texture.

Each vase is unique, yet part of the same system.

🧩 Features:

• Parametric / procedural design

• Knitted surface pattern

• Clean, modern aesthetic

• Ideal for minimal, japandi and contemporary spaces

🖨️ 3D Printing:

• No supports required

• Optimized for PLA

• Recommended layer height: 0.2 mm

• Infill: 5–10%

Perfect as a decorative object or as an exploration of generative design applied to 3D printing.
